cleanup.notes: Delete starter/target to remove compiled classes and test reports. No port or on-disk state is used by the tests; Task 7 uses an in-memory H2 database that exists only while a test or the app runs. Minutes are an authoring estimate, not a measured learner pilot: setup 5 before the day; tasks 55 (tasks 1 to 5 about 31, with the imports that the Task 1 and Task 3 TODOs list already in place and Task 5's DevSecurityConfig shipped empty but with its imports; task 6 about 5 for one bean and one chain line; task 7 about 19 for four retrieval edits without code, in files that each name their page, one learner-written request and five one-line attack requests); 60 minutes with setup. Setup reuses the Spring Boot 4.1.2 artifacts already cached by the earlier Spring labs in the learner's local Maven repository (~/.m2/repository by default); the cache is not removed by cleanup.

licensing: Starter, tests and README: original work for this repository.

Spring Boot 4.1.2, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Hibernate Validator, Nimbus JOSE+JWT (Apache License 2.0), H2 Database (MPL 2.0 or EPL 1.0), JUnit (EPL 2.0) and Apache Maven plugins (Apache License 2.0) are downloaded by Maven at setup; none is committed.
All credential values in this lab (admin-dev-password, the jwt.secret default) are deliberately fake development values, not real secrets.
